comment: File classification consumed by `install.sh upgrade`. Paths are matched against the installed-project layout (post-render, .tmpl stripped). Class lookup order: user_owned → seed_then_user_extends → template_owned (default). Glob semantics: bash globstar — `**` matches multiple path segments, `*` matches a single segment. Pattern docs: docs/setup/upgrade.md.

user_owned.description: Never touched by upgrade. The user's own sprint / retro / design / backlog content lives here, plus the install manifest itself.

seed_then_user_extends.description: Template seeds initial content; user extends in-place. Upgrade flags as 'NEEDS MERGE' — never auto-overwritten by --apply-safe. Hand-merge using the new template version as reference, OR use /flightdeck-upgrade (planned for v0.12) for an LLM-assisted merge.

template_owned.description: Default class. Owned by the template — safely overwritten by --apply-safe on upgrade. If you customized one of these, lift the change to brain-hot.md (project-specific rules section) or a custom preset before upgrading.
